explication: Baserow is a no-code platform for structuring data, building apps and dashboards, automating workflows, and creating AI agents. The principal user journey is to configure a database or other application, then build and use a solution through the platform’s API and interfaces. The tree shows distinct backend subsystems for databases, builders, automations, and agents; the README documents dashboards and Kuma AI as product capabilities. Most implementation links are not shown in the excerpts, so uncertain connections are omitted or marked dashed.
